text_block_list.name: Jun
text_block_list.text:
What a formidable presence..
This foe dwarfs the challenges we have faced thus far.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すさまじい気迫……
今までとは段違いの相手だ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: W-wahh! The air itself is shaking?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ、
空気が震えてるッス！？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text:
I've never faced anything quite like this before...!
Everyone, stay focused!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これほどの相手は初めてかもしれないね……！
みんな、
気を抜かないで！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
As if anything could distract me from such a luscious prize!
Ahhh, I can't wait to do battle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気を抜くなんてもったいないことするものか！
ああ、
早く戦いたいな！
